mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_agent_pending_action (id, tenant_id, run_id, tool_call_id, action_type, request_json, response_json, resolution_digest, status, expires_at, resolved_by, resolved_at, revision, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{a.id}, #{a.tenantId}, #{a.runId}, #{a.toolCallId}, #{a.actionType}, #{a.requestJson}, #{a.responseJson}, #{a.resolutionDigest}, #{a.status}, #{a.expiresAt}, #{a.resolvedBy}, #{a.resolvedAt}, #{a.revision}, #{a.createdAt}, #{a.updatedAt} FROM ds_agent_run WHERE id = #{a.runId} AND tenant_id = #{a.tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.run_id, a.tool_call_id, a.action_type, a.request_json, a.response_json, a.resolution_digest, a.status, a.expires_at, a.resolved_by, a.resolved_at, a.revision, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM ds_agent_pending_action a JOIN ds_agent_run r ON r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.id = a.run_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.run_id = #{runId} AND a.id = #{actionId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.run_id, a.tool_call_id, a.action_type, a.request_json, a.response_json, a.resolution_digest, a.status, a.expires_at, a.resolved_by, a.resolved_at, a.revision, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM ds_agent_pending_action a JOIN ds_agent_run r ON r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.id = a.run_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.run_id = #{runId} AND a.tool_call_id = #{toolCallId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.run_id, a.tool_call_id, a.action_type, a.request_json, a.response_json, a.resolution_digest, a.status, a.expires_at, a.resolved_by, a.resolved_at, a.revision, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM ds_agent_pending_action a JOIN ds_agent_run r ON r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND r.id = a.run_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.run_id = #{runId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'pending' ORDER BY a.created_at, a.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_agent_pending_action SET status = #{statusDb}, response_json = #{res.responseJson}, resolution_digest = #{res.digest}, resolved_by = #{res.resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{res.resolvedAt}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = #{res.resolvedAt} WHERE id = #{actionId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'pending' AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND expires_at > #{res.resolvedAt} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ds_agent_run r WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.user_id = #{userId})
